# VISUALIZATION FOR GROUP DIFFERENCE RECOVERY
# ============================================================================
# This script loads the saved results from the parameter recovery simulation & makes plots
# ============================================================================
# show group recovery differences (mu and lambda) & a density plot for each

# taking the prob of a (probit - probit = answer) is wrong!!! they should both be turned into probit before calculating --> there are issues
# dont convert the contrasts to probability!! --> or add that to the jags analysis script

```{r}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggpubr)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# PATHS
# ---------------------------
root_path <- "~/IGT_LLM_DecisionMaking"
results_dir <- file.path(root_path, "src/3_simulation/WSLS/recovery/results/group_diff")
plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------
# CONSTANTS
# ---------------------------
GROUPS <- c("human", "gpt2023", "gpt2025")
GROUP_COLORS <- c(human = "#3498db", gpt2023 = "#e74c3c", gpt2025 = "#2ecc71")

CONTRAST_NAMES <- c(
gpt2023_human   = "GPT-2023 − Human",
gpt2025_human   = "GPT-2025 − Human",
gpt2025_gpt2023 = "GPT-2025 − GPT-2023"
)
CONTRAST_COLORS <- c("#e67e22", "#9b59b6", "#34495e")

PARAMS <- c("prob_stay_win", "prob_stay_lose", "epsilon")
PARAM_LABELS <- c(
prob_stay_win  = "P(Stay | Win)",
prob_stay_lose = "P(Stay | Lose)",
epsilon        = "Exploration (ε)"
)

probit_to_prob <- pnorm
ROPE_WIDTH <- 0.05
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------
# HELPERS
# ---------------------------
recovery_stats <- function(true, rec) {
  tibble(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((rec - true)^2)),
    Bias = mean(rec - true),
    r    = cor(true, rec) #SD is 0 for a lot of them
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# LOAD DATA
# ---------------------------
results <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "group_params_recovery.csv"))

#in probit
contrasts <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "group_contrasts_recovery.csv"))

samples_list <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "samples_list.rds"))
true_params  <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "true_params.rds"))
```


# ---------------------------
# 1. GROUP μ RECOVERY
# ---------------------------
```{r}
#add the true value and then the mean? (like sam did)

# Pivot results to long format
mu_long <- results %>%
  select(sim_id, group, starts_with("true_mu_"), starts_with("rec_mu_"), 
         -ends_with("_prob")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("true_mu_"), starts_with("rec_mu_")),
    names_to = c("type", "param"),
    names_pattern = "(true|rec)_mu_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = probit_to_prob(value))

# Pivot to wide for plotting (getting the vals)
mu_wide <- mu_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

#get the true vals for each group
true_by_group <- mu_long %>%
  filter(type == "true") %>%
  group_by(group, param) %>%
  summarise(true_mu = unique(value), .groups = "drop")

mu_plots <- map(PARAMS, function(param){
  df <- mu_wide %>% filter(param == !!param) #combine them
  true_vals <- true_by_group %>% filter(param == !!param) #unique operator
  
  # Calculate stats per group
  stats_by_group <- df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((rec - true)^2)),
      Bias = mean(rec - true),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Create stats label with per-group metrics
  stats_label <- paste(
    sapply(1:nrow(stats_by_group), function(i) {
      sprintf("%s: RMSE=%.2f, Bias=%.2f",
              stats_by_group$group[i],
              stats_by_group$RMSE[i],
              stats_by_group$Bias[i])
    }),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = true, y = rec, color = group)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Recovered"), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = true_vals, aes(x = true_mu, y = true_mu, shape = "True Value"), 
               color = "black", size = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("True Value" = 17, "Recovered" = 16), 
                       name = NULL) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1)+ #identity line (perfect recovery)
    labs(
      title = PARAM_LABELS[param],
      x = "True Probability",
      y = "Recovered Probability",
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = min(df$true), y = max(df$rec), 
      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3
    )
})

combined_mu <- ggarrange(plotlist = mu_plots, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mu_recovery_by_group_prob_ggplot.png"),
       plot = combined_mu, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

# ---------------------------
# 2. GROUP CONTRAST RECOVERY (not in probability: in probit)
# ---------------------------
```{r}
#this is all in probit, not transformed to probability since its contrast (can't do this later)

#contrasts:

#sim_id 1
#parameter 1
#true_diff_gpt2023_human -0.6511129
#true_diff_gpt2025_human 0.3686382
#true_diff_gpt2025_gpt2023 1.0197511 
#rec_diff_gpt2023_human -0.09810933
#rec_diff_gpt2025_human 0.728904720
#rec_diff_gpt2025_gpt2023 0.827014

contrast_long <- contrasts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ends_with("gpt2023_human"), ends_with("gpt2025_human"), ends_with('gpt2025_gpt2023')),
    names_to = c("type", "contrast"),
    names_pattern = "(true_diff|rec_diff)_(.*)" #true_diff, rec_diff
  )

true_by_group <- contrast_long %>%
  filter(type == "true_diff") %>%
  group_by(contrast, parameter) %>%
  summarise(true_mu = unique(value), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot wide for plotting (has the true and rec next to each other!!! nicely)
contrast_wide <- contrast_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

contrast_plots <- map(PARAMS, function(param){
  df <- contrast_wide %>% filter(parameter == param)
  true_vals <- true_by_group %>% filter(parameter == param) #unique operator

  # Calculate stats per contrast
  stats_by_contrast <- df %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((rec_diff - true_diff)^2)),
      Bias = mean(rec_diff - true_diff),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Create stats label with per-contrast metrics
  stats_label <- paste(
    sapply(1:nrow(stats_by_contrast), function(i) {
      sprintf("%s: RMSE=%.2f, Bias=%.2f",
              CONTRAST_NAMES[stats_by_contrast$contrast[i]],
              stats_by_contrast$RMSE[i],
              stats_by_contrast$Bias[i])
    }),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = true_diff, y = rec_diff, color = contrast)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, aes(shape = "Recovered")) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = CONTRAST_COLORS, labels = CONTRAST_NAMES)+
    scale_shape_manual(name = "", values = c("Recovered" = 16, "True Value" = 17))+
    labs(
      title = PARAM_LABELS[param],
      x = "True Difference (probit)",
      y = "Recovered Difference (probit)",
      color = "Contrast"
    ) +
    geom_point(data = true_vals, aes(x = true_mu, y = true_mu, shape = "True Value"), size = 4, color = "black")+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "topleft") +
    annotate(
      "text", x = min(df$true_diff), y = max(df$rec_diff),
      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3
    )
})

combined_contrast <- ggarrange(plotlist = contrast_plots, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "group_contrast_recovery_prob_ggplot.png"),
       plot = combined_contrast, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


# ---------------------------
# 3. DENSITY PLOT OF THE RECOVERED VALUES VS THE ONE TRUE VALUE FOR EACH PARAM (THE GROUND TRUTH)
# ---------------------------
```{r}
density_plots <- map(PARAMS, function(param){
  posterior_df <- bind_rows(lapply(1:length(samples_list), function(sim_id){
    samp <- samples_list[[sim_id]]
    param_col <- paste0("mu_", param, "_raw")
    
    bind_rows(lapply(1:length(GROUPS), function(group_idx){
      tibble(
        group = GROUPS[group_idx],
        value = probit_to_prob(samp[[param_col]][, group_idx]),
        # we take the raws (non-probit) and convert to probabilities
        sim_id = sim_id
      )
    }))
  }))
  
  #single true val for each grp
  true_df <- tibble(
    group = GROUPS,
    value = sapply(1:length(GROUPS), function(i) {
      g <- GROUPS[i]
      param_name <- paste0(param, "_raw")
      probit_to_prob(true_params[[g]]$mu[[param_name]])
    })
    #we take the raw value and turn it from probit to prob
  )
  
  ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = value, fill = group)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +  
    facet_wrap(~group, scales = "fixed") + 
    geom_vline(
      data = true_df,
      aes(xintercept = value),
      color = "black",        
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1
    )+
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS) + #color by grp
    labs(
      title = paste("Posterior Density of", PARAM_LABELS[param]),
      x = "Probability",
      y = "Density",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top", #remove it?
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
})

# Combine and save
combined_density <- ggarrange(plotlist = density_plots, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mu_density_by_group_prob_ggplot.png"),
       plot = combined_density, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
